plain_description: **Bring popular AI assistants into one app for everyday work.** Chat with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and local models, and create images with DALL·E 3. Desktop and mobile apps are available.
technical_description: Chatbox is a desktop client for ChatGPT, Claude, and other language models, with Windows, macOS, and Linux support, plus iOS, Android, and a web version. It supports providers including OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and Ollama; features include local data storage, streaming replies, prompt libraries, team collaboration, and DALL·E 3 image generation.
title: Chatbox (Community Edition)
